newsitem.title: USA: General Automation to buy Sequoia unit.
newsitem.headline: General Automation to buy Sequoia unit.

text.p: General Automation Inc said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Sequoia Systems Inc unit Sequoia Enterprise Systems in a deal worth $11 million.
Sequoia Enterprise is a software company specializing in fault tolerant computing systems and enterprise servers.
General Automation will pay about $11 million comprised of cash, common stock and deferred payments. General Automation will also assume some $3 million in liabilities.

General Automation said in a statement the combined businesses will increase General Automation revenues by about 85 percent over the next 12 months. The deal is expected to be close within the next few weeks.
